sections.content: You know *es necesario que* and *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27, and *recomiendo que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 7. New here: *conviene que* works the same way. Use them to say what society and institutions should do.

items.spanish: Es necesario que el Gobierno apoye a las familias.
items.english: It is necessary that the government support families.

items.spanish: Es importante que mejoremos el acceso a la educación.
items.english: It is important that we improve access to education.

items.spanish: Conviene que las instituciones apoyen a las personas sin empleo.
items.english: It is advisable for institutions to support unemployed people.

items.spanish: Recomiendo que se creen más oportunidades de formación.
items.english: I recommend that more training opportunities be created.

sections.content: *Conviene que* is softer than *es necesario que*, but both take the subjunctive: *Conviene que apoyemos a las familias.*
